units.source_text: 四五个赤身的汉子，以赛跑者站在起点线上的姿势，弓着身子，在河滩上顶着急流拉纤。

en.t: Four or five bare-chested men, bent over like runners poised at the starting line, were hauling a towrope against the swift current on the riverbank.

units.source_text: 我们望着他们，一边向桥头走去。

en.t: We watched them as we walked toward the end of the bridge.

units.source_text: 忽然间响起一阵孤寂而深沉的声音，道子压低嗓音说了一句：

en.t: Suddenly a lonely, deep voice sounded, and Michiko lowered her voice and said:
